details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K5, K7, and K8 are fully represented with supporting sentences covering all core material meanings. K3 is missing entirely - no mention of ESA's INFLECION Phase 1 agreement or SEK 11.8M EPS-Sterna order. K4 is missing entirely - no operational milestones for Sedna satellites, CubeCAT terminals, or VIREON satellite assembly. K6 is missing entirely - no discussion of strategic market positioning through AI-enhanced services or shift to recurring revenue streams. The summary captures most financial performance, restructuring, institutional investment, liquidity management, and post-reporting events, but omits three HIGH-importance items related to major contracts, operational milestones, and strategic positioning, resulting in a Generally yes rating.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. It presents a clear narrative of AAC Clyde Space's 2025 financial performance with consistent directional changes (decreases in sales/EBITDA for Products & Missions, increases for Data & Services) and logical cause-effect relationships (operational delays explained in S7-S9 directly tie to revenue shifts in S1-S3 and S8). The summary maintains consistent terminology and scope throughout, with no self-contradictions. While S4 notes 'third consecutive year of positive EBITDA' while showing a decline from SEK 46.7M to SEK 17.5M, this is logically consistent as the prior years presumably had positive (but lower) EBITDA figures not disclosed here. The arithmetic differences between segment and consolidated figures are not contradictions per evaluation rules, as the candidate does not claim exhaustive additivity. Organization flows logically from top-line results to segment performance to profitability, cash flow, capital structure, and forward outlook.
